description: Fed pause with sticky services inflation has historically pressured rate-sensitive real estate and favored the dollar.
Strategic-mineral export controls tend to re-rate domestic and allied producers higher over the next one to three months.
Maritime chokepoint stress usually lifts energy risk premia and supports oil-linked equities.
Semiconductor policy shocks tend to raise volatility first and only later separate winners from losers.
Bank liquidity shocks often favor defensive hedges and selective exposure rather than broad directional bets.
Positive guidance revisions typically support momentum in the reporting sector over the next few weeks.
